svg.aria-label: Rev A INT board tone map: every socket pin, plug position, header pin, J8 pad and test point labelled with what it should tone to on the bare board.

g.text: pivac INT rev A — tone map, COMPONENT side up, plugs at the top, Pi header at the left
Not to scale. Pin order and nets are the board's (hardware/int-board/int-board.kicad_pcb). Bare board: off the Pi, sockets empty, transformer off.
J5 Pi header (socket on the solder side)
TP2 must NOT tone to TP3
Meter checks — board OFF the Pi, chips OUT, 24 VAC OFF
A pins (odd, bottom row) tone TP1: the VS rail
K pins (even, bottom row) read ~12 kΩ to their plug position; no tone to TP1 or TP3
E pins (odd, top row, from the right) tone TP3: Pi ground
C pins (even, top row) tone their Pi header pin only; never TP3, never the E pin beside them
every plug COM (position 4) tones TP2; TP2 never tones TP3
J4.1 and J4.2 are the transformer; neither is COM. Powered, chips out: ~35 V DC TP1 to TP2
pin order: bottom row 1→8 left to right; top row 9→16 RIGHT to LEFT, so 16 is beside the notch
